details: 486 linear compileVideoFilterChain rawvideo byte comparisons: yuv420p/yuv422p/yuv444p x 5x3/9x7/16x12 x 27 shift sets (0, +/-1, +/-3, larger than plane, +/-255 on every option) x smear/wrap, noise and gradient frames

448 CLI (createMediaBackend) comparisons: -vf (linear) and -filter_complex (graph) x rawvideo and framecrc x 7 descriptions x 2 sizes x 8 source/target cases incl. implicit nv12/rgb24/bgr24/gbrp conversions with -cpuflags 0
24 compileVideoFilterGraph and 24 createReplayVideoExecution rawvideo comparisons with split/hstack/vstack/nullsink branches
24 createFrameActors (actor) rawvideo comparisons and 96 createTimedVideoBackend (timed) CLI comparisons in rawvideo and framecrc, with and without -frames:v 2

24 refusal cases on linear/graph CLI and timed backend: yuva420p and rgba (native status 0, refused here with no output), cbh=256, crv=-256, edge=2, rh=1 (native non-zero status, refused here with no output)
1 record of the native gray -> yuvj444p negotiation divergence

unsupported: yuva420p (refused: native leaves the alpha plane unwritten)
high-bit-depth, yuvj*, yuv440p, yuv411p, yuv410p, yuva422p, yuva444p formats (absent from the shared negotiation table)
expression-valued options (only decimal integers and smear/wrap/0/1)
gray input with implicit conversion: native negotiates yuvj444p, EdgeFFmpeg negotiates yuv444p and output differs; cannot be refused without a shared edit

proposedContracts.name: refuses chromashift yuva420p and out-of-range options before output where native accepts or fails them
proposedContracts.scope: yuva420p/rgba refusal and option range/value refusals with no output

notes: Shared edit needed (not made): native negotiates gray input to full-range yuvj444p, but the shared negotiation table (video-ops/formats.ts) has no yuvj444p and descriptor hooks only receive the negotiated format, so implicit gray -> chromashift produces yuv444p bytes that differ from native and cannot be refused from the owned module. Fix by adding yuvj444p to the table, or by giving formats/validate the source format.
Native negotiates packed RGBA sources to yuva444p; the shared table chooses yuva420p, which validate refuses explicitly, so those inputs fail explicitly rather than diverging.
Setup durations: submodule update 45s, npm ci 9s, reference:build 188s, baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 56s, baseline unit suite 84s.
Environment: Node 22 as provided; FLAC and resample-checkpoint baseline failures as documented.
